rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a physical calendar showing dates.

example.english: I look at the calendar every morning to see what date it is.
example.traditional: 我每日朝早都會睇日曆，睇吓今日係幾號。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 tai2 jat6 lik6 tai2 haa5 gam1 jat6 hai6 gei2 hou6

rows.note: Use this formal term for a system of reckoning time, such as the Gregorian or Islamic calendar.

example.english: Different calendar systems calculate months differently.
example.traditional: 唔同曆法對月份嘅計算方法都唔一樣。
example.jyutping: m4 tung4 lik6 faat3 deoi3 jyut6 fan6 ge3 gai3 syun3 fong1 faat3 dou1 m4 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this for an organisation's or club's list of planned activities and events.

example.english: The student union has released next month's calendar of activities.
example.traditional: 學生會已經出咗下個月嘅活動日程。
example.jyutping: hok6 saang1 wui2 ji5 ging1 ceot1 zo2 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 wut6 dung6 jat6 cing4
